frozen_artifacts.doctrine: the registry FREEZES the evidence artifacts by content hash (fs-blake3 of the exact bytes). The battery recomputes every hash; ANY post-hoc edit to a frozen artifact — including a 'harmless' widening of a band, partition, or claim — turns CI red. Legitimate evolution mints a v2 artifact beside the frozen v1 and records a predecessor link; in-place edits are the attack this freeze exists to stop.
